news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
